question: Who is credited with declaring this mantra of the God of gods?
premises: The mantra is identified as belonging to the God of gods.
The mantra is described as having been declared.
The declaration is attributed to the sage Garga.
inference: The sage Garga is the authoritative transmitter of this mantra of the God of gods.
uncertainties: The exact grammatical analysis of ṛṣi+gargaiḥ as an instrumental plural or honorific form is not fully certain.
The syntactic role of the final tokens ṛṣi gargaṃ- in relation to the preceding clause is unclear from this verse alone.
plain_english: This mantra of the God of gods was declared by the sage Garga, the sage Garga.
